claim: File Gateways store data directly in Amazon S3, so you are billed by Amazon S3 for the objects stored and the requests made by your File Gateway.
question: Who bills for the storage and requests of an S3 File Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: storage and requests of a File Gateway

evidence.quote: File Gateways store data directly in Amazon S3. You are billed by Amazon S3 for the objects stored and requests made by your File Gateway.

note: d25-130. Pricing dimension only, no dollar amount.

claim: For volume and tape gateways you are billed for the amount of volume and virtual tape data you store in AWS, prorated daily, and only for the capacity you use, not for the provisioned size of the resource. Prices vary by Region.
question: How are volume and virtual tape storage billed on Volume and Tape Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: volume and virtual tape storage in AWS
qualifiers.condition: billed on used capacity, prorated daily

evidence.quote: You are billed for the amount of volume and virtual tape data you store in AWS. This fee is prorated daily and prices vary by region. You are only billed for the portion of volume or virtual tape capacity that you use, not for the provisioned size of the resource.

claim: There is no Storage Gateway charge for reading data from AWS.

qualifiers.scope: data read from AWS by a gateway
qualifiers.condition: data written to AWS is charged

evidence.quote: There is no charge for reading data from AWS.

note: d25-130. The same FAQ answer charges a flat per-GB rate for data written to AWS up to a monthly maximum per gateway; the dollar amounts are not recorded.

question: How much data written to AWS is free per account on Storage Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: data written to AWS, per account
qualifiers.condition: footnote to the monthly per-gateway maximum on the pricing page

evidence.quote: The first 100 GB written to AWS per account is free.

note: d25-130. Pricing page; the dollar amounts in the same footnote are not recorded.

claim: You are billed for Internet data transfer for each GB downloaded from AWS to your gateway. All data transfer for uploading to AWS is free.
question: Does AWS charge for data transferred into AWS through Storage Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: network data transfer to and from AWS with Storage Gateway

evidence.quote: You are billed for Internet data transfer for each GB downloaded from AWS to your gateway. All data transfer for uploading to AWS is free.

claim: You are charged an early deletion fee if a virtual tape is deleted within three months of being archived in S3 Glacier or within six months of being archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive. There is no deletion charge after three months in S3 Glacier or six months in S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
question: When is an early deletion fee charged for an archived virtual tape?

qualifiers.condition: minimum storage period per archive class

evidence.quote: If a virtual tape is deleted within three months of being archived in S3 Glacier or within six months of being archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive, you will be charged an early deletion fee. If the virtual tape has been stored for three months or longer in S3 Glacier or for six months or longer in S3 Glacier Deep Archive, there is no charge for deletion.

note: d25-130. Chapter 21 owns S3 storage class minimum durations.

claim: Moving a tape from S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive incurs a tape move charge, plus an early deletion fee for S3 Glacier if you move the tape within 90 days.
question: What charges apply when you move a virtual tape from S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive?

qualifiers.scope: moving an archived tape from S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive
qualifiers.condition: early deletion fee applies only if the tape is moved before 90 days

evidence.quote: You will incur a tape move charge for moving a tape from S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive and if applicable, an early deletion fee for S3 Glacier, if you move a tape from S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive prior to 90 days.

claim: Using a VPC endpoint with Storage Gateway is billed for each hour the endpoint remains provisioned, plus data processing charges for each gigabyte processed through the endpoint regardless of the traffic's source or destination.
question: What are the cost dimensions of a VPC endpoint used with Storage Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: VPC endpoint used with Storage Gateway

evidence.quote: You will be billed for each hour that your VPC endpoint remains provisioned. Data processing charges also apply for each Gigabyte processed through the VPC endpoint regardless of the traffic’s source or destination.

claim: EBS snapshots taken from Storage Gateway volumes are stored and billed by Amazon EBS, and a new snapshot stores only the data that changed since the last snapshot.
question: Who bills for snapshots taken from Storage Gateway volumes?

qualifiers.scope: EBS snapshots of Storage Gateway volumes

evidence.quote: EBS snapshots taken from your Storage Gateway volumes are stored and billed by Amazon EBS. When taking a new snapshot only the data that has changed since your last snapshot is stored to reduce your storage charges.

claim: Uploading files from an S3 File Gateway to Amazon S3 when S3 versioning is turned on commonly results in more than one version of an S3 object, which increases S3 storage.
question: How does S3 versioning affect the storage cost of data uploaded through an S3 File Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: S3 File Gateway uploads to a bucket with S3 versioning on

evidence.quote: Uploading files from your File Gateway to Amazon S3 when S3 versioning is turned on commonly results in more than one version of an S3 object.
These scenarios increase S3 storage if S3 Versioning is turned on and increase the transfer costs associated with CRR.
